mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.tenant_id, n.approval_instance_id, n.node_no, n.node_code, n.status_code, n.original_approver_user_id, n.current_approver_user_id, n.project_scope_version, n.assessment_review_decision_code, n.assessment_review_reason, n.feedback, n.decide_time, n.pending_marker, n.version, n.creator, n.create_time, n.updater, n.update_time, n.deleted, n.approval_mode_code, n.candidate_role_id, n.candidate_role_code, n.candidate_group_key, n.qualification_kind_code, n.qualification_outcome_code, n.qualification_role_code, n.qualification_project_version, n.qualification_participant_fact_version, n.qualification_required_action_code, n.qualification_allowed_flag, n.qualification_check_time, n.decision_actor_user_id, n.decision_role_id, n.decision_membership_version, n.decision_user_status_version, n.decision_check_time FROM cut_approval_node n JOIN cut_approval_instance i ON i.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND i.id = n.approval_instance_id AND i.deleted = b'0' JOIN cut_task t ON t.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND t.id = i.task_id AND t.deleted = b'0' WHERE n.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND AND n.node_no = i.current_node_no AND n.status_code = 'PENDING' AND n.deleted = b'0' AND i.status_code = 'PENDING' AND i.hold_reason_code IS NULL AND i.replacement_approval_instance_id IS NULL ORDER BY i.create_time ASC, i.id ASC, n.id ASC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize}
